answer: Mint a non-transferable marble for every piece of work independent peers verify, so reputation cannot be bought or moved between identities. Stack trust as a terrace: newcomers start on the lowest step with small rewards, and each higher terrace requires marbles earned on the step below plus a fresh proof from a different verifier. A sybil farm can spawn many accounts, but each must climb every terrace from the bottom, and the ridge is narrow — identical low-effort bursts from many accounts at once slide off it and trigger review, so scale stops paying.
